mapper.insert: insert into learning_agent_task (user_id, session_id, task_type, status, progress, input_json, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{taskType}, 'PENDING', 0, #{inputJson}, #{idempotencyKey}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select task_id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, progress, input_json, output_json, error_msg, retry_count, idempotency_key, create_time, start_time, finish_time, update_time from learning_agent_task where task_id = #{taskId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update learning_agent_task set status = 'RUNNING', progress = 5, start_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'PENDING'
update learning_agent_task set status = 'SUCCESS', progress = 100, output_json = #{outputJson}, error_msg = null, finish_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}
update learning_agent_task set status = 'FAILED', error_msg = left(#{errorMsg}, 500), finish_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}
update learning_agent_task set progress = #{progress}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING'
update learning_agent_task set status = 'CANCELED', finish_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

update learning_agent_task set status = 'FAILED', error_msg = left(#{errorMsg}, 500), output_json = #{outputJson}, finish_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: select task_id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, progress, input_json, output_json, error_msg, retry_count, idempotency_key, create_time, start_time, finish_time, update_time from learning_agent_task where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1
